title: Restart Tipper Cycle After Fault or E-Stop Using Visu_MCP_Dual Buttons
summary: Use the primary operator HMI screen "Visu_MCP_Dual" (Tipper Machine Control Panel) to reset the tipper system after a fault (RESET → CYCLE START) or after an E-stop (ESTOP RESET → AUTO → CYCLE START). Active buttons are indicated by illuminated green bars.
when_to_use: When the tipper system needs to be reset and the tipper operation cycle restarted after a fault or after an E-stop, using the primary operator screen "Visu_MCP_Dual".
not_for: Do not use this procedure to jog the tipper. The screen notes that only maintenance personnel should jog the tipper.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the RESET / ESTOP RESET and AUTO / CYCLE START button sequence on the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen and verify the expected restart behavior.
safety_notes: Only maintenance personnel should jog the tipper (JOG is maintenance-only per the screen description).

system_preconditions: Operator station is able to display the "Visu_MCP_Dual" (Tipper Machine Control Panel) screen.

visual_references.description: Visu_MCP_Dual (Tipper Machine Control Panel) showing the informational banner, AUTO, JOG, REF, CYCLE START, CYCLE STOP, RESET, AUTO REF, and ESTOP RESET buttons; active buttons indicated by illuminated green bars.
Operator Station HMI Data Screen (VISU_DATA) showing the informational banner with right-side arrows for navigating messages and the Tipper Stats section.
Operator Station HMI Manual Control Screen (VISU_MANCONTROL) showing maintenance-level manual controls (not required for this reset/restart procedure).
Operator station screen photo from a non-recoverable fault recovery procedure showing AUTO and CYCLE START sequence context and RESET after the robot leaves the tipper.

steps.title: Open the primary operator screen "Visu_MCP_Dual" (Tipper Machine Control Panel)
steps.purpose: Access the tipper control panel buttons used for fault/E-stop reset and cycle restart.
steps.instruction: On the operator station HMI, navigate to the primary screen labeled "Visu_MCP_Dual" (Tipper Machine Control Panel).
steps.expected_result: The "Visu_MCP_Dual" button panel is visible, including RESET, ESTOP RESET, AUTO, and CYCLE START buttons, with active buttons indicated by illuminated green bars.
steps.healthy_condition: The screen is responsive and shows the button panel with green illuminated bars above any currently active buttons.
steps.failure_condition: The "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen is not accessible/does not load, or the expected buttons (RESET/ESTOP RESET/AUTO/CYCLE START) are not visible.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The Tipper Machine Control Panel ("Visu_MCP_Dual" screen) has buttons that control tipper movement and allows for fault reset; bars above the buttons illuminate green to indicate which buttons are active.
F3 navigates to the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen; NOTE: This will be the primary screen that operators need to use.

steps.title: Check the informational banner for alarms/messages and navigate if needed
steps.purpose: Confirm there are no additional alarm/informational messages that require attention before resetting/restarting.
steps.instruction: On the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen, check the informational banner at the top for alarm/informational messages. If multiple messages exist, use the right-side arrows to navigate through them.
steps.expected_result: The informational banner shows alarm/informational messages, and the right-side arrows can be used to navigate through messages.
steps.healthy_condition: Banner messages are readable and navigation arrows respond (messages change as you navigate).
steps.failure_condition: Banner messages are not visible/readable, or the right-side arrows do not navigate through messages.

actions.label: Inspect banner messages
actions.exact_action: Check the informational banner at the top of the screen for alarm/informational messages.

actions.label: Navigate banner messages
actions.exact_action: Use the right-side arrows to navigate through messages in the banner.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: An informational banner displaying alarms or informational messages; arrows on the right side of the banner can be used to navigate through messages in the banner.

steps.title: If in a fault state, press RESET then confirm active green bar
steps.purpose: Reset the system after a fault so the tipper cycle can be restarted.
steps.instruction: If the system is in a fault state, press the "RESET" button and confirm its active green bar illuminates.
steps.expected_result: The "RESET" button shows as active (illuminated green bar above the button).
steps.healthy_condition: RESET becomes active (green bar illuminates) indicating the reset action was accepted on the screen.
steps.failure_condition: Pressing RESET does not illuminate the active green bar, or the system does not proceed to allow cycle restart as expected.

actions.label: Fault reset
actions.exact_action: Press the "RESET" button (confirm its active green bar illuminates).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the expected restart does not occur after pressing the documented reset sequence (RESET→CYCLE START).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Item 7: RESET resets the system after a fault; bars above the buttons illuminate green to indicate which buttons are active.
Figure 4-19 shows the Visu_MCP_Dual operator control panel with RESET and green active bars.

steps.title: Press CYCLE START to restart the tipper operation cycle
steps.purpose: Restart the tipper operation cycle after a fault reset.
steps.instruction: Press "CYCLE START" to restart the tipper operation cycle (confirm the cycle start action is accepted on the screen).
steps.expected_result: The "CYCLE START" action is accepted on the screen (CYCLE START becomes active/accepted as indicated by the screen’s active button indication).
steps.healthy_condition: CYCLE START is accepted and the system proceeds with the tipper operation cycle restart.
steps.failure_condition: The cycle does not restart after pressing CYCLE START.

actions.label: Start cycle
actions.exact_action: Press "CYCLE START" to restart the tipper operation cycle (confirm the cycle start action is accepted on the screen).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the expected restart does not occur after pressing the documented reset sequence (RESET→CYCLE START).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Item 7: Press CYCLE START to restart the tipper operation cycle; Item 5: The CYCLE START starts the tipper operation cycle when the system is on "Auto" mode.

steps.title: If after an E-stop, press ESTOP RESET then AUTO then CYCLE START
steps.purpose: Reset the system after an E-stop and restart the tipper operation cycle.
steps.instruction: If the system is after an E-stop, press "ESTOP RESET" (confirm its active green bar illuminates), then press "AUTO", then press "CYCLE START" to restart the system.
steps.expected_result: ESTOP RESET becomes active (green bar illuminates), AUTO is selected, and CYCLE START is accepted to restart the system.
steps.healthy_condition: The system restarts the tipper operation cycle after the sequence ESTOP RESET → AUTO → CYCLE START.
steps.failure_condition: The system does not restart after completing the documented E-stop reset sequence.

actions.label: E-stop reset
actions.exact_action: Press "ESTOP RESET" (confirm its active green bar illuminates).

actions.label: Start cycle
actions.exact_action: Press "CYCLE START" to restart the system.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the expected restart does not occur after pressing the documented reset sequence (ESTOP RESET→AUTO→CYCLE START).
Do not attempt to jog the tipper unless you are maintenance personnel (JOG is maintenance-only per the screen description).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Item 9: ESTOP RESET resets the system after an E-stop; press AUTO, then CYCLE START to restart the system. Active buttons are indicated by illuminated green bars.
Figure 4-19 shows the Visu_MCP_Dual operator control panel with ESTOP RESET, AUTO, and CYCLE START buttons and green active bars.

success_criteria: After a fault reset, pressing CYCLE START restarts the tipper operation cycle.
After an E-stop reset, completing ESTOP RESET → AUTO → CYCLE START restarts the system.
Active buttons show illuminated green bars above the pressed/active controls.
healthy_conditions: RESET (fault case) or ESTOP RESET (E-stop case) shows an illuminated green active bar when pressed.
CYCLE START is accepted on the screen and the tipper operation cycle restarts.
failure_conditions: The expected restart does not occur after pressing the documented reset sequence (RESET→CYCLE START for faults, or ESTOP RESET→AUTO→CYCLE START for E-stop).
Active green bars do not illuminate above the expected buttons after pressing them.
escalation_guidance: If the expected restart does not occur after the documented reset sequence, stop and escalate.
